title: Migrate build, validation, and gateway concept roots
summary: Move compiler build, validation report/preflight, codewiki_build/codewiki_validation tools, and gateway transaction ownership into source-root build/validation/gateway concepts while preserving public behavior and proof policy.

goal.outcome: Build, validation, and gateway concepts have source-root ownership under src/build/**, src/validation/**, and src/gateway/**, with old layer-first owner paths removed or retained only as explicit temporary shims.
acceptance: Create src/build/** owner modules for build types, lifecycle helpers, decision-propagation helpers, build writer/use-case execution, and codewiki_build tool execution moved from src/domain/build/**, src/application/builds.ts, and src/application/tools/build.ts.

Create src/validation/** owner modules for validation types, validation report writing, validation preflight/risk policy, and codewiki_validation tool execution moved from src/domain/validation/**, validation-owned sections of src/application/builds.ts, and src/application/tools/validation.ts.
Create src/gateway/** owner modules for gateway transaction helpers moved from src/application/gateway/** when they are validation/gateway-owned rather than generic application plumbing.

Update adapters, schemas, graph/resume/task callers, tests, scripts, and package smoke to import build/validation/gateway behavior from src/build/**, src/validation/**, src/gateway/**, or stable public API paths, not old layer-first owner paths.

Preserve codewiki_build and codewiki_validation tool schema/result behavior; decision/planning/implementation build output shape; validation report/preflight semantics; task-close/publication content-proof policy; package loading; direct Node execution; and smoke/feature coverage.
Add or update TASK-specific tests proving old build/validation/gateway layer-first imports are gone or any temporary compatibility shims are explicit, scoped, and test-backed.

Update file-structure KB/diagram to mark the build/validation/gateway wave status and keep session, roadmap, state/graph/resume, project, knowledge, GC, and change roots gated until TASK-022 task-close evidence exists.
non_goals: Do not migrate session, roadmap, state/graph/resume, project, knowledge, GC, change, adapters, UI, or skills in this task.
Do not change public tool schemas, validation profile names, package metadata, package entrypoints, build JSON schema, validation JSON schema, or product behavior.
Do not remove source paths outside the build/validation/gateway boundary except import updates required by this migration.

delta.desired: Build, validation, and gateway concepts have source-root ownership under src/build/**, src/validation/**, and src/gateway/** with public behavior preserved.
delta.current: Build and validation/gateway code remain split across src/domain/build/**, src/domain/validation/**, src/application/builds.ts, src/application/tools/build.ts, src/application/tools/validation.ts, and src/application/gateway/**.
delta.closure: Implementation build and validation prove build/validation/gateway migration, compatibility-preserving imports, updated tests/KB/diagram, and no non-wave source migration.
